correctness.rationale: Kummer carries plus explicit four-state matrix including the terminal carry give a bijection between all k-bit padded indices and correctly weighted paths. Formal resolvent algebra proves the rational bivariate identity for all k. Derivative coefficient extractions give exact mean and factorial moment; finite integer regression with separate Legendre factorial valuations agreed for 8191 input checks through length 12, and symbolic recurrence/moment checks through length 30. Infinite correctness depends on the explicit matrix proof, not those tests.

originality.rationale: The novelty claim is restricted to the exact rational bivariate distribution over every length/valuation. Kummer and Fibbinary zero layer, OEIS A036556 valuation parity, OEIS A029907 numerical two-layer and Drmota–Krattenthaler leading 11/12 variance/CLT are explicitly treated as covered rather than novel. Full primary texts for the most relevant binomial and digit-sum directions were inspected; no exact corresponding all-layer rational generating identity was located. Earlier implicit finite-state derivations remain possible.
residual_risks: A direct unindexed exact all-layer formula may already exist, including as an application of digit automata.
OEIS A029907 provides exactly the numeric sequence for the valuation-two count, so its univariate values are covered.
The leading variance and central limit theorem already follow from published general results and are not new.

value.rationale: The exact distribution for the canonical binomial diagonal across every dyadic cutoff is a natural completion of the heavily studied Fibbinary odd layer. Unlike a single finite census, one rational identity classifies all prime-two valuations at every cutoff, exhibits a structural forbidden valuation, supplies adjacent-layer relations and exact first and second moments. These finite-length data are not implied by the published limiting normality or isolated OEIS sequences. No unrelated grand conjecture is claimed.
